name: Power Corrupts: Paragon
source: Paragon is a visual novel in which the player is one of the first superheroes to manifest at the dawn of a new age. With only comic books and movies to use as a template, your choices determine how the world sees you, and the rest of your kind.
translation: 在视觉小说《典范》中，玩家将扮演新时代黎明之际首批觉醒现身的超级英雄之一。在仅有漫画书与电影可供效仿参照的世界里，你的每一个选择都将决定世人如何看待你——以及你的全体同类。
